items.snippet: Growing Lithium Demand and Productivity Aid Albemarle. Albemarle is well-placed to gain from long-term growth in the battery-grade lithium market. ALB expects lithium demand to witness a compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10-20% from 2025 to 2030.
